# Use approved words

Coding rule · `S1.1`

Use the approved glossary (brain/context/glossary.md) in all new UI copy, docs, test cases and reports. Roles: Admin, Sales Agent, Business Agent, Business Sales Agent. Activity = timeline item (type + date + note); Note = only the text body; Stop (not Waypoint); Plan in UI, Pack
